description: NaTeF₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na¹⁺ is bonded to seven F¹⁻ atoms to form distorted NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with five equivalent TeF₅ square pyramids, edges with two equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one TeF₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.50 Å. Te⁴⁺ is bonded to five F¹⁻ atoms to form distorted TeF₅ square pyramids that share corners with five equivalent NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramids and  an edgeedge with one NaF₇ pentagonal bipyramid. There are a spread of Te-F bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.01 Å. There are three inequivalent F¹⁻ sites. In the first F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Te⁴⁺ atom. In the second F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na¹⁺ and one Te⁴⁺ atom. In the third F¹⁻ site, F¹⁻ is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na¹⁺ and one Te⁴⁺ atom.
